endorsements.name: Arif Hussain
endorsements.label: Rolling in the Dough: How Microsoft Identified and Remediated a Baker’s Dozen of Security Threats in the Windows DNS Server
endorsements.description: This talk is a collaboration between the team who identified several vulnerabilities in the Windows DNS Server and the team who fixed them. As a security researcher in the Microsoft Security Response Center, George will discuss the motivations behind exploring this attack surface, the prior research that inspired this work, and the significance of this attack surface for future researchers.
